screening: Adult recent buyer within six months or active buyer planning within three months.
Ask about actual tasks, constraints and payer involvement; no AI-use requirement.
Record overlap; assign exactly one primary cohort without duplicating participants.

intent.effect: Route the journey. Offer check, existing-device and browse routes bypass unrelated discovery questions.
intent.scope: Review against Android/new-laptop slice; categories, financing and existing-device expansion are deferred.

category.effect: Choose question and catalog scope. Unknown routes to a clarification, not an arbitrary default.
category.scope: Review against Android/new-laptop slice; categories, financing and existing-device expansion are deferred.

budget.effect: User-confirmed hard ceiling in VND for the stated purchase scope. Values are illustrative preset ceilings, not market benchmarks. Unknown means no budget-personalized eligibility claim.
budget.scope: Review against Android/new-laptop slice; categories, financing and existing-device expansion are deferred.

laptop_uses.effect: Select all actual uses. Tasks route follow-ups; occupation does not set hardware minimums.
laptop_uses.scope: Review against Android/new-laptop slice; categories, financing and existing-device expansion are deferred.

phone_uses.effect: Select all actual uses. Show relevant follow-ups; daily apps do not imply demanding workloads.
phone_uses.scope: Review against Android/new-laptop slice; categories, financing and existing-device expansion are deferred.

desktop_uses.effect: Select all actual uses. Route task-specific requirements and build scope.
desktop_uses.scope: Review against Android/new-laptop slice; categories, financing and existing-device expansion are deferred.

condition.effect: Explicit new/used restriction. Unknown is not permission to recommend used as equivalent; disclose the assumption or ask before selecting a used offer.
condition.scope: Review against Android/new-laptop slice; categories, financing and existing-device expansion are deferred.

laptop_priorities.effect: Soft ranking priorities only. Choosing two must never discard any selected task or required feature.
laptop_priorities.scope: Review against Android/new-laptop slice; categories, financing and existing-device expansion are deferred.

phone_priorities.effect: Soft ranking only. Keep camera measurement, battery evidence and support facts distinct.
phone_priorities.scope: Review against Android/new-laptop slice; categories, financing and existing-device expansion are deferred.

desktop_priorities.effect: Soft ranking only; cannot override electrical, physical or workload compatibility.
desktop_priorities.scope: Review against Android/new-laptop slice; categories, financing and existing-device expansion are deferred.

must_have.effect: A marked must-have becomes a hard constraint. Brand or aesthetic preferences are not automatically hard requirements.
must_have.scope: Review against Android/new-laptop slice; categories, financing and existing-device expansion are deferred.

required_software.effect: Retrieve vendor compatibility requirements and relevant workload evidence. Merely selecting an app does not confirm performance.
required_software.scope: Review against Android/new-laptop slice; categories, financing and existing-device expansion are deferred.

vm_count.effect: Workload intensity signal; refine memory/CPU guidance with workload evidence rather than a universal RAM rule.
vm_count.scope: Review against Android/new-laptop slice; categories, financing and existing-device expansion are deferred.

gaming_titles.effect: Identify relevant game/anti-cheat/platform requirements; do not substitute a generic gamer label.
gaming_titles.scope: Review against Android/new-laptop slice; categories, financing and existing-device expansion are deferred.

gaming_target.effect: Translate goals through relevant evidence. Custom numeric targets need a supported measurement basis.
gaming_target.scope: Review against Android/new-laptop slice; categories, financing and existing-device expansion are deferred.

creative_scale.effect: Avoid bundling unrelated project-size meanings into one generic heavy-work option.
creative_scale.scope: Review against Android/new-laptop slice; categories, financing and existing-device expansion are deferred.

phone_camera.effect: Weight relevant measured camera behaviors rather than megapixels.
phone_camera.scope: Review against Android/new-laptop slice; categories, financing and existing-device expansion are deferred.

phone_charging.effect: Context for battery priorities, not a promise of all-day measured runtime.
phone_charging.scope: Review against Android/new-laptop slice; categories, financing and existing-device expansion are deferred.

required_os.effect: A required platform is a hard constraint; lack of requirement does not establish app compatibility.
required_os.scope: Review against Android/new-laptop slice; categories, financing and existing-device expansion are deferred.

accessibility.effect: Use non-diagnostic language and hands-on checks. Do not infer needs from age or require medical information.
accessibility.scope: Review against Android/new-laptop slice; categories, financing and existing-device expansion are deferred.

pc_scope.effect: Set explicit basket scope before a within-budget complete-build claim.
pc_scope.scope: Review against Android/new-laptop slice; categories, financing and existing-device expansion are deferred.

pc_reuse.effect: Check exact retained models and missing critical compatibility. Do not assume generic part names are enough.
pc_reuse.scope: Review against Android/new-laptop slice; categories, financing and existing-device expansion are deferred.

current_device.effect: Identify actual configuration and upgrade support; do not require a full new-device questionnaire.
current_device.scope: Review against Android/new-laptop slice; categories, financing and existing-device expansion are deferred.

current_problem.effect: Identify need for diagnosis or compatibility checks. A complaint alone is not proof of a hardware fault or bottleneck.
current_problem.scope: Review against Android/new-laptop slice; categories, financing and existing-device expansion are deferred.

purchase_timing.effect: Prioritize actual stock/deadlines or optional alerts. Date entry appears only when needed.
purchase_timing.scope: Review against Android/new-laptop slice; categories, financing and existing-device expansion are deferred.

delivery_area.effect: Required before location-dependent delivery/stock totals can be verified; not necessary to browse general fit.
delivery_area.scope: Review against Android/new-laptop slice; categories, financing and existing-device expansion are deferred.

payment_mode.effect: Keep total budget separate from payment schedule; do not infer loan eligibility or convert a monthly figure into a hidden larger purchase cap.
payment_mode.scope: Review against Android/new-laptop slice; categories, financing and existing-device expansion are deferred.

buying_for.effect: Supports separate decision profiles and collaboration; no age, salary or identity is required.
buying_for.scope: Review against Android/new-laptop slice; categories, financing and existing-device expansion are deferred.

sessionPrompts: Tell me about the last time you chose a laptop. What happened first?
Show how you compared the last two options, if comfortable.
Which required task or cost ruled an option out?
Try choosing with your own needs; explain when you think changes become confirmed.
Explain whether this fitting device has a verified affordable offer.
Review an AI-proposed edit: what changed before and after confirmation?
Reopen a saved decision: which price is historical and what needs refreshing?
What was unhelpful or confusing? What would you use instead?

consent.procedure: Explain voluntary participation, purpose and anonymized use before starting; separate optional recording permission; stop on withdrawal.
consent.contactStorage: Outside repository; never store contact details in protocol outputs.

retention.proposal: Delete optional raw recordings within 30 days after coding; anonymized notes retained only with agreed scope.
retention.status: proposed; confirm with participant before collection

data.redundancyReview: Broad bank has routing/financing/ownership questions outside this slice. Do not ask every bank question in each session; ask only questions with an applicable decision effect. No observed redundancy rates yet.

gaps.reason: No authorized participant observation records supplied or found.
gaps.nextAction: Recruit four recent or active laptop buyers in each cohort; obtain consent and record anonymized task outcomes.
